name: Los Cerralbos (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, light blue and green with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Los Cerralbos (a cross and a ladder).
history: Municipal flag of Los Cerralbos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Los Cerralbos arms — cross on blue and ladder on red above mountains
cross, ladder and crown of the arms
